units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 5:4:3">Y. Ab. Zar. V, 44ᵈ</cite> <he>את סבר הדא … לק׳ וכ׳</he> you may think that this opinion of R. S. b. G. is an alleviation, but it is nothing but a restriction.

<cite ref="Beitzah 3b:7">Bets. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>כל ספיקא דרבנן לק׳</he> a doubtful case in which a rabbinical enactment is under consideration, is decided in favor of the easier practice; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S00342"><he>קוּלִּין</he></cite>, <he>קוּלֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 55a:1">Pes. 55ᵃ</cite> top <he>תנא ק׳ ק׳ קתני</he> the teacher (in saying there is no difference &c., 54ᵇ) speaks only of alleviations (permitted acts).
